counter_account.description: The account on the counter side.

counter_amount.description: How much of the counter asset changed hands.

counter_asset.description: The counter asset: XLM, or CODE:ISSUER for an issued asset.

liquidity_pool_fee_bp.description: For a pool trade, the pool's fee in basis points.

liquidity_pool_id.description: For a liquidity pool trade, the pool's ID.

price.description: Counter asset per one unit of the base asset.

list_transactions.description: List the transactions of a Stellar account or of one ledger, or the network's latest: hash, time, fee in XLM, number of operations, memo and whether each succeeded.
list_transactions.name: list_transactions

parameters.description: Only this account's (an ID starting with G). Leave empty, with no ledger, for the whole network's latest.
parameters.name: account

parameters.description: Only those in this ledger, by its number. Use instead of an account.
parameters.name: ledger

parameters.description: Newest first or oldest first. Defaults to newest first.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: How many to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The next_cursor from an earlier page, to get the page after it. Leave empty for the first page.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Also include those from transactions that failed.
parameters.name: include_failed

next_cursor.description: Give this as Cursor to get the next page; empty when nothing came back.

fee_account.description: The account that paid the fee.

is_fee_bump.description: True when another account paid its fee (a fee bump).

max_fee.description: The most it offered to pay, in XLM.

memo.description: Its memo, if it has one.

memo_type.description: text, id, hash, return or none.

description: Read the Stellar network through Horizon, its public API: account balances and signers, payments with their memos, transactions, operations and ledgers, issued assets, the decentralized exchange's order books, trades and price history, payment path quotes, liquidity pools, claimable balances and fees. Triggers run on new payments to or from an account and on new trades for an asset pair. No account or API key required.

stellar_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs for each payment to or from a Stellar account, including the payment that opens it, with the amount, asset and memo. Payments made before the workflow is turned on never run it.

output.amount: The amount delivered, exact; empty for an account merge.
output.asset: The asset delivered: XLM or CODE:ISSUER.
output.asset_code: The delivered asset's code, e.g. USDC.
output.direction: received or sent (self when the account paid itself).
output.from: The account the money came from.
output.memo_type: text, id, hash, return or none.
output.source_amount: For a path payment, the amount the sender paid.
output.source_asset: For a path payment, the asset the sender paid in.
output.successful: Always true: failed payments don't run it.
output.to: The account the money went to.
output.transaction_hash: The hash of the transaction it was in.
output.type: payment, create_account, path_payment_strict_send, path_payment_strict_receive, account_merge or invoke_host_function.
output.type_label: The kind of payment in words, e.g. Account created.

parameters.description: The account to watch: an ID starting with G, 56 characters long.
parameters.name: account

parameters.description: received to run only for money coming in, sent only for money going out. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: Only payments of this asset: XLM, or an issued asset written CODE:ISSUER. Leave blank for every asset.
parameters.name: asset

stellar_new_trade_trigger.description: Runs for each trade of an asset pair on Stellar's decentralized exchange, order book and liquidity pool alike, with both amounts and the price.

output.base_account: The account on the base side.
output.base_amount: How much of the base asset changed hands.
output.base_asset: The base asset: XLM or CODE:ISSUER.
output.base_is_seller: True when the base side sold the base asset.
output.counter_account: The account on the counter side.
output.counter_amount: How much of the counter asset changed hands.
output.counter_asset: The counter asset: XLM or CODE:ISSUER.
output.liquidity_pool_fee_bp: For a pool trade, its fee in basis points.
output.liquidity_pool_id: For a liquidity pool trade, the pool's ID.
output.price: Counter asset per one unit of the base asset.
